Changed Datum's S1 Skyport station from x 530 to 545. At 530 it was 190 m along the line from Harbour (x 340), which breaks S-S2 (min 200). At 545 the platform runs x 520–570 on the trunk and on the straight loop lead, which reaches x 600.

Open issue for Datum: Skyport (545,0) is over water and no road or foot path in the plan reaches it. `fronts: crown-parade` is a placeholder only. It needs a skyport apron or foot path added to the plan. I have not moved any geometry.

N-R1 reach, by hand: worst plots are crescent-north (98,247), 247 m from S1/circus, and crown-terraces (-168,247), 247 m from S1/gardens. Both are under 250 m but have no margin. rocket-west and lantern-west are only in reach because of T2/sunset. Without T2 they fail (rocket-west is 273 m from T1/records).
Interchange pairs: T1/circus–S1/circus 119 m, T1/records–T2/market 55 m, T2/harbour–S1/harbour 33.5 m. All are within 150 m, so the network is one connected whole (N-C1).

Waymark: T2/sunset and T2/market sit on Market Street, outside the Records Precinct gates (Rocket Lane, Satellite Street). These are places police can seal. T2/market is 40 m east of the T1×T2 diamond. Pulse: the busiest transfer crowd stands at Boulevard/Market.
T2 depends on Sky accepting the line (Datum's open question). If T2 is dropped, rocket-west fails N-R1 and T1/records loses its interchange; the stops would need to be placed again.
